newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop loan increased to HK$10.8 bln.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop loan increased to HK$10.8 bln.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd's revolving credit/term loan facility has been completed and increased to HK$10.8 billion from HK$10.5 billion, a company spokesman told Reuters on Friday.
The facility, launched through Sun Hung Kai Properties (Financial Services) Ltd, had a final maturity of seven years and paid a margin of 48 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
The issue is a revolving credit facility in the first three years of its life and converts to a term loan thereafter.
Proceeds would be used for refinancing existing debt and for general working capital.
